hero.title: Venus
hero.subtitle: Photographic Aesthetics Evaluation
hero.tagline: Professional photographic aesthetics evaluation powered by adversarial multi-agent review
hero.lede: From a single photo to a whole series, Venus proposes, challenges and arbitrates to deliver scores, critique, actionable advice and verifiable evidence.
hero.sheetNoteText: See the relationships between photos first, then form a judgment.

hero.frameForestAlt: Sample photograph of light and shadow in a forest
hero.frameWaterAlt: Sample photograph of water surface texture

modes.title: Choose an evaluation mode
modes.description: From the close reading of a single frame to series narrative and side-by-side comparison, pick the mode that matches the question you are working on.

single.title: Single review
single.description: Assess composition, light, subject, technical execution and visual impact of one work, with a full verdict and actionable advice.

joint.title: Joint series review
joint.description: Treat 2–10 photos as one series and assess overall narrative, visual consistency, rhythm and completeness.

compare.title: Comparative review
compare.description: Compare 2–10 photos under one standard to get a ranking, scores, a difference summary and the evidence behind each judgment.

process.title: Not a one-off answer, but an evidence-based aesthetic debate.
process.lede: Three reviewing roles examine each work from different positions, so scores withstand challenge and advice carries back into the next shoot and edit.

genre.title: Genre identification
genre.description: Identify the photographic genre to select the assessment dimensions and context that fit the work.

proposal.title: Proposer's initial review
proposal.description: Read the photo and form dimension scores, critique and preliminary advice.

challenge.title: Critic's challenge
challenge.description: Check the initial review for bias, thin evidence and inconsistent scoring.

verdict.title: Arbitrator's verdict
verdict.description: Weigh both arguments into a final score, ranking or series conclusion.
